research_question: Under the frozen transient-service simulation, which declared retry delay policy has the lowest observed p95 successful completion latency while satisfying reliability and mean-attempt constraints?
claim_boundary: Only the policies, stochastic service model, seeds, constraints, and selection rule frozen in protocol.json. Results are simulation evidence, not a production guarantee.

ideation.instructions: Turn every declared policy into a falsifiable hypothesis without choosing a winner.

literature.instructions: Record the predeclared engineering sources. Do not assert novelty because this run does not retrieve and compare full source content.

experiment.instructions: Run every policy on every frozen seed, save all row-level observations, and report only metrics computed from those rows.

analysis.instructions: Recompute all summaries from raw observations, apply the frozen eligibility and ordering rules, and state the selected policy without a hardcoded expected answer.

review.instructions: Independently recompute the result from raw observations and reject the claim if the analysis differs from the frozen rule.
